unit_label: BRBL::MOD_D::U28: Distinguish bribery,commercial-organisation exposure and criminal misconduct

payload.title: Classify the alleged conduct before choosing an offence
payload.core_explanation_md:
The source distinguishes receiving an undue advantage, influence-related conduct, giving/promising it, commercial-organisation exposure, responsible-officer conduct and abetment. The offence elements and applicable exceptions must be established for the particular actor. A company payment does not automatically prove every director personally committed the same offence.

The amended criminal-misconduct definition includes the described dishonest/fraudulent misuse of entrusted property and intentional illicit enrichment. Disproportionate resources and the lawful-source explanation require the statutory evidentiary analysis. Ordinary loss-making lending is not automatically proof of dishonest conversion. Repeat-offence and attempt provisions also have defined conditions; do not extend a provision addressing one clause to every attempted act.

self_check.prompt_text: Does every bad commercial outcome automatically establish criminal misconduct?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. The applicable statutory conduct and evidence must be established.

payload.stem_md: A loan later defaults and the file labels that outcome alone dishonest misappropriation without identifying conversion or the required conduct. What is missing?

options.text_md: The offence elements and supporting evidence
options.explanation_md: A loss outcome alone does not prove the specified misconduct.

options.text_md: A rule that public servants can never be investigated
options.explanation_md: The statute provides investigative routes subject to the applicable powers and safeguards; it does not give blanket immunity.
It does not establish the offence.

options.text_md: A presumption that every commercial risk is illegal

payload.correct_explanation_md: A loss outcome alone does not prove the specified misconduct.

payload.stem_md: A company-associated bribery allegation is made, and a note treats every director as automatically convicted solely by title. Which distinction is necessary?

options.explanation_md: The applicable responsibility conditions still matter.

options.text_md: Companies can never face any bribery-related exposure
options.explanation_md: The source identifies a commercial-organisation provision.

options.text_md: Entity exposure and each officer applicable responsibility/elements
options.explanation_md: The actors and provisions must be analysed separately.
Turnover alone does not prove each offence.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The actors and provisions must be analysed separately.
